content.rendered: Archer Glen will have school pictures on Wednesday, Oct. 26th. Picture packets will be sent home in student’s backpacks on Wednesday, Oct. 12th. Online ordering is available at mydorian.com. Search for Archer Glen Elementary, then select the date to access everything needed all in one location. Retake day will be Friday, Dec. 2nd.
